brief.subject: PepsiCo lifts deforestation-free sourcing to 94%
brief.headline: PepsiCo reports 94% deforestation-free sourcing for key commodities in 2025
brief.dek: PepsiCo raises its share of forest-clearance-free ingredients like palm oil, while Starbucks reports record inventory availability.
brief.lede: PepsiCo says 94% of key ingredients, including palm oil, were sourced without forest clearance in 2025. That is up from 90% a year earlier.

sections.heading: PepsiCo raises deforestation-free share
bullets: 94% of key PepsiCo ingredients, such as palm oil and sugar cane, came from sources without forest clearance in 2025.
The prior year's figure was 90%, showing major buyers track deforestation-free sourcing year over year.
Palm oil is an EUDR commodity, so suppliers to big food brands face overlapping corporate and EU data demands.

sections.heading: Starbucks touts record inventory availability
bullets: Starbucks' CEO says store inventory availability is at an all-time high, supported by daily deliveries.
The chain is testing a 24-hour operating model aimed at a faster, more dependable supply chain.
The report covers logistics only and gives no detail on coffee sourcing or deforestation checks.

brief.seo_description: PepsiCo reports 94% deforestation-free sourcing of palm oil and other key ingredients in 2025, up from 90%. Plus Starbucks supply chain news.

items.title: Starbucks inventory availability at ‘all-time high’ with daily deliveries, CEO says
items.snippet: The coffeehouse chain has been testing a 24-hour operating model to improve inventory availability and build a faster, more reliable supply chain.

items.title: PepsiCo improves deforestation-free sourcing for key commodities
items.snippet: The Doritos maker sourced 94% of ingredients such as palm oil and sugar cane without forest clearance in 2025, up from 90% the year before.
